observations.body: As people wonder whether John is the Christ, he names a mightier one whose baptism differs from his and whose threshing separates wheat and chaff.
observations.label: Expectation turns toward the one who baptizes in Spirit and fire

observations.body: The passage presents Baptizing and threshing as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Baptizing and threshing

observations.body: The passage places Expectant crowds beside Baptizing and threshing.
observations.label: Expectant crowds

payload.posture: Read Luke 3:15–17 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states as people wonder whether John is the Christ, he names a mightier one whose baptism differs from his and whose threshing separates wheat and chaff. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: Expectation turns toward the one who baptizes in Spirit and fire
